name: strip
description: One strip of quiet pills above the prompt in place of the SYS, PLAN, HANDOFF and CACHE rows: context, cache, diff, tests, agents, queue, system and peers, with a STOP and a health pill when needed. It reads the other mods' state, orders the whole band, and opens a context, a system and a last-turn diff pane. /strip.

rows.title: The SYS, PLAN, HANDOFF and CACHE rows
rows.description: hide: the strip stands in their place (a HANDOFF row with something to act on still shows); show: they are drawn under the strip as before. /strip rows show|hide overrides this.

transparentPanes.title: Panes without a background fill
transparentPanes.description: On: a pane any mod opens without a background colour of its own is drawn with no fill, so the terminal shows through. /strip panes clear|solid overrides this.
